name: clip
summary: 6 key moments, 2 jumps: ready -> deep crouch -> jump -> land -> landing stance -> deep squat -> rising crouch -> jump -> land -> crouch arms forward -> standing upright (finish)
action: The body repeatedly lowers into a crouch, jumps vertically with both feet leaving the ground, lands, and rises before repeating.

stages.name: deep crouch
stages.description: The body lowers from standing into a deep crouch with the arms reaching down and forward in preparation for takeoff.

stages.name: landing stance
stages.description: The body travels through the air and returns to the ground, rising toward a tall stance with the arms moving outward.

stages.name: deep squat
stages.description: The body lowers from standing back down into a deep crouch with the arms reaching forward.

stages.name: rising crouch
stages.description: The body starts rising from the crouch with the arms moving back as the second jump begins.

stages.name: crouch arms forward
stages.description: The body descends from the airborne phase into a crouch with the arms swinging forward at chest height.

stages.name: standing upright (finish)
stages.description: The body rises from the crouch to a standing upright position with the arms held in front of the chest.

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
